objective: Pause output on overlapping VAD, decide within 500 milliseconds, and make TurnChangePacket the only committed interruption
acceptance_criteria: VAD start during assistant output sends one internal pause without context rotation or TTS and LLM interruption
Meaningful STT before the deadline emits one TurnChangePacket
Speech active at the deadline emits one TurnChangePacket
Speech ended without meaningful text sends one internal continue at the deadline
TurnChangePacket flushes output before interrupting old TTS and LLM work
Held meaningful STT is replayed once into the new context
Late candidate events cannot affect a later turn
Every configured streamer consumes pause, continue and flush before rollout
implementation_order: Define internal PauseOutput, ContinueOutput and FlushOutput stream values
Add one requestor-owned candidate and fake-clock deadline handling
Change VAD and STT adapter handlers to emit pause, continue or TurnChangePacket
Make TurnChangePacket the ordered commit owner
Add output-control consumption to every streamer
Add conditional lifecycle transition and stale model-result rejection
Verify all packages and obtain independent code review

required_tests: no context rotation during pending candidate
ended filler-only speech continues at deadline
late STT and deadline are ignored
turn change orders flush before old-work interruption and held-text replay

concurrency.rule: One lock owns the sole candidate and its timer
concurrency.timer: The callback enqueues a deadline packet and never mutates candidate state directly
concurrency.duplicates: Repeated activity and late events are idempotent no-ops after the candidate closes

failure_behavior.flush_failure: Log and keep the accepted turn change
failure_behavior.session_close: Stop the timer and discard held evidence

verification: just agent-finalize with exact changed paths
rollback: Revert the complete interruption change set and restore direct legacy VAD handling. Do not enable the adapter path until all streamer consumers exist.
